lines.text: Hi, this is Sam from Northwind customer care. Sorry about the trouble with NW182. As a goodwill gesture I can offer you a £75 travel voucher.
I understand. I can offer £150 as a cash payment instead.
Let me check with my supervisor... OK, I can go up to £300 in cash.
Fair point, operational reasons don't count as extraordinary. I'll process the full £350 to your original payment method.
